data.gender_notes: Arlyn is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Arlyn is derived from the Greek words ‘aros’ meaning mountain and ‘lynx’ meaning eagle, resulting in the meaning ‘mountain eagle’. This name holds symbolism of strength, resilience, and agility. The name Arlyn carries the meaning “Mountain eagle” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Arlyn usually hope their child will grow to embody mountain eagle and live with faith, good character and purpose.
